content.text:
The key dispute is IP ownership. They want uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence, we want contract_research_company_owns. This is a hard limit for us - we need to own the results to integrate into SoundSlot and expand to new markets. Let me counter: I can move on exclusivity (accept 12 months) but push back to company ownership. I'll trade by accepting the 12-month exclusivity reduction and keep everything else, but insist on company_owns_uni_academic_use as a compromise.

I can change at most two fields. I'll change ip (from uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence to company_owns_uni_academic_use) and keep exclusivity at 12 months (accepting their reduction). That's one change (ip), accepting their exclusivity move.
